verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's homepage presents CHKit as its own tool, offering typed commands an agent can drive in CI to describe, validate, test, and deploy schema and pipelines as code. That is a first-party, agent-oriented command tool, but the evidence never explicitly calls it a CLI and its scope is limited to schema and pipelines. Compatibility with stock ClickHouse clients and the MCP server belong to other stories and are not credited here. Missing for 10: explicit CLI documentation (install, command reference), CLI coverage of service and cluster management, querying and monitoring, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
